text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult woman with long black hair gathered into paired tails, fine curled face-framing strands, reddish brown eyes and pale neutral skin. Elaborate silver floral headdress with pale pink crystals, pearl chains and matching long earrings. Ivory blush ceremonial gown with dimensional floral details, pearl ornaments and delicate translucent sleeves over an opaque bodice. Continue the ivory-blush ceremonial gown into a full opaque floor-length bell skirt with floral embroidery, pearl chains and layers of fine tulle; ivory satin flats just peeking at hem. Graceful tall healthy 177 cm build. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
